title: Welcome to the feature tour
text: Welcome to the feature tour of Powering the Great Grid. This microsite supports the new hundred and eighty kilometre power line from Norwich to Tilbury, and the thousands of jobs it will bring. It helps school pupils, college and university students, and adults looking for work, to try, plan and apply for forty-two green energy careers in Norfolk, Suffolk and Essex. First, six quick stops on this home page, and then the guide continues page by page.

title: Four simple menus
text: Everything sits under four headings: Explore careers, Try a V W E, Plan my future, and For teachers and partners. The same headings appear on every page, with a trail showing where you are, so nobody gets lost.

title: A route for every learner
text: Choose school pupil, college student, university student, or adult looking for work, and you get a step-by-step route with links. You can tick steps off as you go, so each visitor has a clear next step.

title: Career finder
text: Four quick questions match each learner to the job families that suit them, with routes, partners and next steps. It turns, I don't know what I want to do, into a short list of ideas in a couple of minutes.

title: Explore 42 roles
text: Seven job families, six roles each. Pick a family to see every role, its entry route, and its thirty-minute key stage three taster.

title: Private partner dashboards
text: Engagement and talent pipeline data are for National Grid and the partners only, behind a partner sign-in. The public site never shows them.

title: Films and questions
text: Watch the product film and the testimonial film, then read answers to the questions learners and parents ask most.

title: Continue the tour on each page
text: From here the guide moves page by page, twelve stops in all. Start with the V W E library, or jump straight to any stop you like.

title: VWE library
text: The V W E library holds seven five-day virtual work experiences, with forty-two job tasters, all free. Filter by job family and stage, or search for a role. Switch on available now to see what runs today, and open any role's linked lessons, or ask to be told when it launches.

title: A day on site
text: This is a day on site, as an Overhead Line Electrician. Turn on B S L and the reading tools first: bigger text, tints and read aloud. Then play the clip, answer the quiz, make the site decisions, handle the curveball, and write your site diary to earn the certificate.

title: One VWE, two jobs
text: Here the evidence report turns a learner's choices into proof of what they can do. Pick a learner, read their report, and see marks for aptitude, competency set and soft skills. Move the ranking sliders, and watch the shortlist change. It replaces a C V with evidence.

title: Careers planner
text: The careers planner gives each learner a step-by-step plan. Choose a target job, your stage and your county, and get lessons, V W Es, courses and employers in order. Tick steps off, then save or share your plan.

title: How you can progress
text: Every job family is a six-rung career ladder. Pick a family, open a rung to see the job, the pay band and how to move up, and explore the sideways moves into other families. It shows how far a first job can lead.

title: Colleges and courses
text: This page matches courses to roles. Filter by county or by the role you want, open a provider to see its relevant courses and links, and find the universities that lead to graduate roles.

title: Partners and jobs map
text: A live map of jobs and training along the route. Search jobs, or tap a quick chip such as apprenticeships. Click pins on the map, switch on the colleges layer, and book a placement with an accessibility profile.

title: Linked lessons
text: Twenty-four Developing Experts lessons, each linked to the careers and V W Es they lead to. Filter by stage and family, and search by topic, such as electricity or habitats. It gives every teacher a quick way into careers in their own subject.

title: Teacher training
text: Teacher training takes thirty minutes for each job family. Pick one of the seven families, work through six short modules, and pass the quiz to download a C P D certificate.

title: Lesson unit library
text: The unit library puts lessons in a teaching sequence, in order, then the V W E. Try the demo view as a signed-up teacher to unlock every lesson, and mark lessons as taught for a class, to see what comes next.

title: School sign-up
text: Finally, school sign-up. Check eligibility with a school postcode, fill in the school, your details and the data choices, and see what happens next. That's the tour. Thank you for watching.
